question_stem:
A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected to two identical filament lamps A and B, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1

The current-voltage ($I$-$V$) characteristic for each lamp is shown in Fig. 5.2.

{{figure:figure_5_2}}

Fig. 5.2

The potential difference across the battery terminals is $6.0\text{ V}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use Fig. 5.2 to show that the current in the battery is $0.40\text{ A}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.part_stem: The e.m.f. of the battery is $6.8\text{ V}$.
parts.text: Calculate the internal resistance $r$ of the battery.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the ratio $\frac{\text{resistance of lamp A}}{\text{resistance of lamp B}}$.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
1. the total power produced by the battery,
2. the efficiency of the battery in the circuit.
